about: Each identity AGENT_SECRETS_MACHINE_IDENTITY names, with the variables it needs, in the order its clients read them: a client that is given none of them refuses the first, then the next once the first is set, and builds the identity once all are set.

clients names the clients that take the kind: go is packages/envoy/internal/cipherclient (MachineIdentity), typescript is packages/cipher-client (machineIdentity). A Go tool refuses device-login by name.

example is a value each client takes for the variable. TestEveryMachineIdentityReadsTheCorpusVariablesInOrder (machine_identities_test.go) and packages/cipher-client/src/__tests__/machine-identities.test.ts hold each client to this file, which is how the two are held to one list.
